name: Gold
description: A few coins, clipped at the edges and black in the creases. Money spends the same however long it sat in the dark.
notes: Money (mw-e01.6): what a loot table rolls into a container's gold, so a chest can hold a few coins. Taken from a container it goes to the gold counter, never into the pack (mw-e17.3, mw-e18.3); its id matches the `gold` the container window and pickup notes report it under.
